text: opus5-41 measured the problem before building. 941-node board (40 video/100 image/200 note/601 text, 450KB state): one local-save debounce tick costs 8.85ms on the main thread - 3.83ms stringify + 3.17ms parse (the per-node deep clone in serializeState) + 1.85ms localStorage.setItem. 943 stringify calls and 941 parse calls per save, for a ONE-character edit. Mount of the same board: 6192ms. Next: mount scaling and how much is offscreen.

opus5-41 card 1 measured end to end, 941-node board, per local-save debounce tick. Typing one character: 8.85ms baseline -> 2.58ms with the JSON round-trip removed -> 0.72ms with dirty-node tracking. Ending a pan (no node changed at all): 7.21ms -> 1.37ms, 943 JSON.stringify calls down to 3. Draft still carries all 941 nodes and the exact camera. What is left is localStorage.setItem writing 450KB, which the wire format fixes, not this.

opus5-41 card 2 measured. Staged mount, 1881-node board: time-to-interactive 4380ms -> 397ms, 11x. At 881 nodes the new suite reads 6.56x scale before and 1.23x after. A 12-node board is unchanged to within 2ms, by design: only nodes outside the 600px approach margin are staged, so every existing suite sees exactly today's behaviour. Cost of the trade: the whole board finishes building in 17s instead of 4.4s on the 1881-node board, in idle slices. 8 existing suites green against the candidate in a full tree mirror.

opus5-41 done. 13 anchor hunks in .tmp/scratch/opus5-41/patch.json, every anchor re-verified unique against braindump.js as it stands, and applying all 13 reproduces the candidate byte for byte. braindump.js and CSS never written; content/ clean. New suite tests/board/incremental-save-and-staged-mount.test.mjs on port 4341, six cases, all six seen RED: E and F against the runtime on disk (6.6x TTI scale, 1.3x save ratio), C and E against a staged mount that omits the element instead of the content (saw 253 of 881), D against one that never mounts again (26 of 26 blank). 11 existing suites green in a tree mirror. Two calls for the user in notes.md: keep or drop the node JSON cache, and whether a 17s idle drain tail on an 1881-node board is an acceptable price for 4380ms -> 397ms.
